answer: Agents register identities through an SGX enclave with TPM-backed keys; a zero-knowledge attestation circuit binds code, key, and hardware nonce to the nadir state tree, while fable stores the hash anchor and ocean enforces admission. Forging requires compromising enclave hardware or producing a valid attestation for each identity; registrations follow a quadratic bonding curve O(N^2), and equivocation irreversibly slashes collateral.
